full_judgment: 11. The constitution of the People's Republic of Bangladesh has granted power and has imposed duties upon the public authorities. Our Constitution does not allow any administrative authority to misuse its discretion and/or power. Discretion conferred by the statute has to be exercised honestly and fairly as conferred by the statute having regard to the purpose of the statute conferring it. In this regard, we may refer a case of Novva Ads vs Department of Municipal Administration reported in (2008) 8 SCC 42, wherein it is held that: "there cannot be any presumption that the power so confirmed will be misused ".
